description.value:
Homo sapiens aberrans, the Aberrant strain - a human rewritten before birth by a corrupted zone or a corp gene-lab into something that reads as wrong to clean minds. The mutation gives, and the mutation takes.

Attribute Profile: a floating +1 to one characteristic and a floating -1 to a different characteristic (the +1 applies after the creation cap of 4). Kessic places +1 on Cognition (his machine-mind - the class primary) and -1 on Presence (the cold wrongness that keeps people from meeting his eyes).

Corruption Load at creation: 0. Only the free Minor mutation (Chameleon Hide, Load 0) is taken, so the Fractured Mind flaw sits in the Latent band - a quirk, not a mechanic. Chasing Standard/Signature mutations later raises Corruption Load and wakes the flaw: a genuine risk-reward the player owns.

MutAncAdvFree000.name: Mutant Traits (Free)
MutAncAdvFree000.description: You gain all four Mutant traits below.
